column1: # Partition table for RFID Access on 4 MB flash.
# Derived from arduino-esp32's min_spiffs.csv. Only ONE thing changes: 64 KB is
# taken off each OTA app slot to double the filesystem
# the credential roster and the persistent event spool.
#   min_spiffs   app0/app1 = 0x1E0000 (1.875 MB)   fs = 0x20000 (128 KB)
#   this table   app0/app1 = 0x1D0000 (1.8125 MB)  fs = 0x40000 (256 KB)
# The budget is fixed: after the 64 KB header region and the 64 KB coredump
# 2*app + fs must equal 0x3E0000. So every 64 KB removed from each app slot buys
# 128 KB of filesystem. 64 KB (3.4% of the slot) is a cheap price for twice the
# spool
